intro: Crafted for quiet moments and cozy gatherings, our Splenda table blends rich tones and solid build with effortless style—perfect for your everyday spaces.

features.title: Warm cappuccino finish
features.text: The elegant cappuccino shade adds a touch of warmth and class to your living room—subtle, timeless, and easy to style.

features.title: Smooth and sturdy top
features.text: A durable MDF surface finished with rubber wood veneer provides a natural look that’s smooth to touch and easy to maintain.

features.title: Solid rubber wood base
features.text: With a rubber wood understructure, your table stands strong and steady—offering daily support with enduring charm.

features.title: Ease of assembly
features.text: Thanks to its knock-down construction, you can set it up with ease, move it around when needed, and enjoy flexibility for life.

care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
